Rajasthani Cultural Evening in Jaisalmer

An evening of Rajasthani folk music and traditional dance — live songs, instruments and performances, often at desert camps and cultural venues.

Explore this activity ↗

What to expect

  • Live folk music
  • Traditional dance, including Kalbeliya
  • Traditional costume and instruments
  • An evening out under the stars

Where and when

Desert camps and city venues.

After sunset.

An evening.

Before you go

Ask which musicians or dancers are on that evening, when the performance begins and whether a meal or transport is part of the ticket.

Plan the rest of your visit

  • Sam Sand Dunes, Jaisalmer: safaris, sunset and camps
  • Khuri, Jaisalmer: dunes, desert camps and safari planning
